task.title: P6-157: Add a persistent live region for auth role=alert banners
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-157. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**The four auth `role="alert"` banners are created together with their text, so announcement rests on the AT's insertion heuristic — and on a cold SSR load `role="alert"` in the initial HTML is not announced at all** (was `P6-012a`; `auth_pages.rs:320,404,541,611`, same for `ErrorNote`). Needs a pre-existing live region.
